topics.title: Generate AI insights for SharePoint Advanced Management
topics.summary: The AI insights feature for SharePoint Advanced Management uses a language model to identify patterns and potential issues from reporting and receive actionable recommendations to solve issues.

topics.title: What is the SharePoint Admin Agent?
topics.summary: The SharePoint Admin Agent is an AI-powered governance experience that helps your administrators assess and remediate content-related risks across your SharePoint and OneDrive environments.

topics.title: Create document library with AI
topics.summary: By using Copilot in SharePoint to create a document library, you can go from a simple description to a well configured, metadata-rich document library. Instead of manually creating a library, defining columns, and setting up tagging rules, describe what the library is for and optionally provide a sample file.

topics.title: Get started with Copilot in SharePoint
topics.summary: Copilot in SharePoint brings agentic capabilities into SharePoint so teams can ask questions, run workflows, and create sites, pages, interactive reports, and Office files from their SharePoint content by using natural language. Videos, prompt guides, and other getting started materials are available here.

topics.title: Create sites with AI
topics.summary: Copilot in Microsoft SharePoint makes it faster and easier to create SharePoint sites and solutions using natural language. Describe what you need, and Copilot in SharePoint recommends a structure—including pages, lists, libraries, and more.

topics.title: SharePoint developer documentation
topics.summary: Build Copilot UX components, web parts, extensions, and business solutions with SharePoint Framework and Microsoft 365.

topics.title: Develop and deploy Copilot UX components
topics.summary: A Copilot UX component solution has two related deployment surfaces: its SPFx components and its baseline declarative agent. Sync to Teams is required for the initial agent deployment and changes to the baseline agent configuration. It isn't required for every component update.

topics.title: Build your first Copilot UX component
topics.summary: In this tutorial, you build a baseline Copilot UX component from scratch, test it locally in the Copilot Workbench, package it, deploy it to the SharePoint app catalog, and use it inside Microsoft 365 Copilot. This gives you the complete end-to-end path for the model: create, test, package, deploy, and use.

topics.title: Overview of Copilot UX components
topics.summary: Copilot UX components are generally available with SharePoint Framework 1.24 , released on October 28, 2026 . For licensing, supported clients, and distribution, see Availability. Review the GA limitations before deployment.

topics.title: Provide Copilot with context from your component
topics.summary: Rendering an interactive component doesn't by itself tell Copilot what the user is looking at. Provide a concise textual description of the current visible state so Copilot can explain the UX in natural language and use the information in subsequent conversation turns.

topics.title: Publish SharePoint Framework applications to the marketplace
topics.summary: Publish SharePoint Framework solutions through Microsoft AppSource and the SharePoint Store so other organizations can discover and install them in their Microsoft 365 tenants. This guidance covers web parts, extensions, and Copilot UX components , which are supported in the SharePoint Store starting with SPFx 1.24 GA.

topics.title: SharePoint Framework v1.24.0 release notes
topics.summary: SharePoint Framework (SPFx) 1.24.0 is generally available on October 28, 2026 . This release makes Copilot UX components generally available, updates the React runtime to React 18.3.1 , and adds support for Node.js 24 and 26 , alongside Node.js 22.

topics.title: New SharePoint Experience
topics.summary: SharePoint is redesigned for simplicity and clarity, centered on discovering, publishing, and building—now with flexible workflows and AI-first capabilities built in.

topics.title: Insights report on agents in SharePoint
topics.summary: The insights report on agents in SharePoint provides SharePoint administrators with rich information on the recently created agents across all SharePoint sites and OneDrive sites within their organization. This report helps admins learn about the sites with the highest number of agents created.
